name: Social Insurance (Bảo hiểm xã hội)
authority: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.33 and art.34 — 8% employee and 17.5% employer, on a salary capped at 20 times the statutory reference level (2,530,000, ceiling 50,600,000). The employer 17.5% is 3% sickness and maternity, 14% retirement and survivorship, and 0.5% occupational accident and disease under the Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.44 with Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP art.4. Floor: Luật BHXH 41/2024/QH15 Điều 31(1)(đ) — tiền lương làm căn cứ đóng thấp nhất bằng mức tham chiếu (2,530,000 đ on this version). Applied 2026-09-18: an employer granted the reduced 0.3% occupational-accident rate (Decree 58/2020 art.5) records the entity fact `occupational_accident_reduced`; its share is then 17.3%. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH art.30(1)–(2): the insurance salary is the contractual salary plus the contractual allowances and fixed supplements (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a meal, fuel, phone or housing allowance is a row marked not fixed and stays outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Above the ceiling (twenty times the reference level) the employer’s share is the ceiling at the employer’s own rate — 17.3% where the occupational-accident fund is reduced (Decree 58/2020 art.4), 17.5% otherwise — the same choice the open rungs make. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): The base recorded is the insurance salary itself — the contractual salary floored at the reference level (2530000.0) and capped at twenty times it (50600000.0) — so a scheme that reads `produced.SI.base` reads the insured salary.

name: Đoàn phí công đoàn (union membership dues)
authority: Trade Union Law 50/2024/QH15 art.29 with Decision 1908/QĐ-TLĐ art.23: a union member pays dues of 1% of the salary the social-insurance contribution is based on, capped at 10% of the reference (base) salary; paid to the union, never by a non-member. The `union_member` election says who is one. Applied 2026-09-18. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH art.30(1)–(2): the insurance salary is the contractual salary plus the contractual allowances and fixed supplements (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a meal, fuel, phone or housing allowance is a row marked not fixed and stays outside.

name: Unemployment Insurance (Bảo hiểm thất nghiệp)
authority: Law on Employment 74/2025/QH15 arts.31 to 33 — 1% of the employee's monthly wage and 1% of the employer's monthly wage fund, on a wage capped at 20 times the regional minimum wage (Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP, unchanged on 1 July 2026). The scheme covers Vietnamese employees; a foreign employee is outside it. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH art.30(1)–(2): the insurance salary is the contractual salary plus the contractual allowances and fixed supplements (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a meal, fuel, phone or housing allowance is a row marked not fixed and stays outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Law 41/2024 art.31(1)(đ) makes the unemployment-insurance base the social-insurance base, so its floor is the version’s reference level — 2,530,000 from 1 July 2026 as for SI, not the earlier 2,340,000.

name: Trade Union Fee (Kinh phí công đoàn)
authority: Law on Trade Unions 50/2024/QH15 art.29, in force 1 July 2025 — an employer levy of 2% of the social-insurance salary fund, payable whether or not a union has been established, on the same 20 times reference level ceiling (50,600,000). Floor: Luật BHXH 41/2024/QH15 Điều 31(1)(đ) — tiền lương làm căn cứ đóng thấp nhất bằng mức tham chiếu (2,530,000 đ on this version). Applied 2026-09-18 (4): Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH art.30(1)–(2): the insurance salary is the contractual salary plus the contractual allowances and fixed supplements (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a meal, fuel, phone or housing allowance is a row marked not fixed and stays outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): Law on Trade Unions 2024 art.29(1)(b) (Decree 191/2013 art.5): the employer’s union fund contribution is 2% of the salary fund on which social insurance is paid — one line on the establishment, the sum of the insured salaries (`produced.SI.base` over the run), not a charge on any payslip.

name: Personal Income Tax (Thuế thu nhập cá nhân)
authority: Law on Personal Income Tax 109/2025/QH15 art.9 with art.29(2), salary rules applied from the 2026 tax period — the five-rung progressive scale, withheld month by month on the monthly table under Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC art.25(1)(b) over the month’s income net of the month’s SI, HI and UI, with the 15,500,000 personal and 6,200,000 dependant monthly deductions written into art.10. Art.4(8) exempts the overtime and night-work wage and the wage paid for untaken leave days, so neither OVERTIME nor ENCASHMENT is in the base from 1 July 2026 (Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP). A non-resident is withheld at the flat 20% through the registration’s rate override. Applied 2026-09-18: the tax year’s last payslip (December, or a leaver’s last) charges the annual scale — the monthly rungs × 12 — on the year’s income net of the year’s SI, HI, UI and the deductions for the months employed, less what the year already withheld (Law 109/2025 art.29(2); Decree 253/2026 art.70): a negative charge is the refund. Before 1 July 2026 the part of the overtime wage above the ordinary rate is outside the base (Circular 111/2013 art.3(1)(i); `OVERTIME_PREMIUM`). Applied 2026-09-18: the tax year’s last payslip (December, or a leaver’s last) charges the annual scale — the monthly rungs × 12 — on the year’s income net of the year’s SI, HI, UI and the deductions for the months employed, less what the year already withheld (Law 109/2025 art.29(2); Decree 253/2026 art.70): a negative charge is the refund. Before 1 July 2026 the part of the overtime wage above the ordinary rate is outside the base (Circular 111/2013 art.3(1)(i); `OVERTIME_PREMIUM`). Applied 2026-09-18 (4): Circular 111/2013 art.2(2): allowances are salary income except the statutory severance and job-loss allowances (`ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward)); art.7: the monthly progressive table is assessed on the month (`assessment_period: MONTH`), so a semi-monthly company withholds each half as part of one month. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Decree 126/2020 art.8(6)(d): the employer finalises on behalf of an employee who is still employed at the time of finalisation and has income from this employer alone; a leaver’s last payslip is withheld month by month and the person finalises with the tax office (`exit_date == ""` on the year-end rung).
